messages:
anna: Starting a paced region rollout today: US -> EU -> APAC. Deploybot draft at 13:45 UTC. Need final capacity check, pin window, and explicit rollback thresholds. @mike @tara please confirm.

mike: US warmup looks fine from night runs. available slots=1250, current avg use 58%, planned headroom ~30%. I propose pin v2.5.0 in US for the initial hour.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] queued job 1748765430: --slice us --version v2.5.0 --strategy phased --notify #eng-releases

tara: Heads-up: EU has a network maintenance at 15:10 UTC that might affect control plane. Can we nudge EU rollout to 15:40 UTC to avoid overlap?

anna: Ok shift EU to 15:40 UTC. Keep APAC at 20:10 UTC. Documented in the runbook: EU reduced concurrency for first 20m. Also include data-regression checks.

mike: Ops smoke checklist: ```
# sanity generate
curl -f -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rwd-gen-1","input":"healthcheck"}'
# GPU mem and utilization
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=utilization.gpu,memory.used --format=csv
```

kai: Noticed APAC staging had two preemptions last night during long conversations. Eviction ~0.5%. Recommend enabling memory-safety for APAC canary: `--mem-safety=soft` and cap max_seq=2048. If OOMs > 0.6% kick rollback for APAC slice.

anna: Agreed. mem-safety=soft for APAC canary. US/EU remain default unless we see pressure. Add to runbook: immediate rollback if OOMs exceed thresholds or error_rate spikes.

sre_bot: [metric] us_canary_p95=370ms, us_canary_error=0.09% 1 min window OK.

mike: Proposed rollback triggers for team vote: error_rate > 1% sustained over 5m, p95 latency > 1.5x baseline for 3m, OOM rate > 0.6% for canary slice. thumbs?

tara: +1. also add eval drift check: if hallucination/top-k regression > 2.5% over baseline -> manual rollback review.

anna: Plan locked: US canary 25% traffic, pin for 1h after success. EU at 15:40 with concurrency cap 55% for first 20m and canary 20%. APAC at 20:10 with mem-safety soft and max_seq limit.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] starting canary for us at 13:45 UTC. command: `deploybot run --slice us --version v2.5.0 --canary=25 --pin=1h`

mike: quick capacity snapshot: `connections=1230/1250, avg_cpu=36%, avg_gpu_mem=50%` 13:48 smoke looks clean.

sre_bot: [log] event: us_canary_start ts=1748765440

kai: KV prefix cache warmed to ~84% after rollout, should keep latency good. watching OOMs closely.

tara: i'll hold EU at 15:35 UTC for a manual greenlight (infra, latency, error budget, customer watchlist).

anna: Decision rule in runbook: if US canary stable for 12m with no triggers -> proceed to EU. If any trigger fires -> immediate pin and rollback US to v2.4.3 and notify stakeholders.

mike: rollback snippet (pre-staged): `deploybot rollback --slice us --to-version v2.4.3 --reason "canary regression"` 1 keep it handy.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] us_canary samples look ok, streaming verified. Awaiting a 12m stable window.

anna: I'll do the 12m check and post go/no-go. thanks, team. :white_check_mark:

kai: will alert if OOM spike >0.2% or cache pressure drops.

sre_bot: [log] event: us_canary_12min_stable ts=1748765450

anna: GO for EU at 15:40 UTC. updating pinboard and release notes. Tara, please coordinate customer comms for EU on standby.

mike: EU run command copied: `deploybot run --slice eu --version v2.5.0 --concurrency-cap=55% --canary=20 --pin=1h`

tara: prepping EU comms now. will call for freeze and rollback if any threshold crosses. APAC remains scheduled with mem-safety soft. Closing thread after EU handoff.
